topic: Stalingrad’s Turning Point: German Troops Reach the Volga
pillar: Events that changed the modern world
hook: When the Nazis finally hit the Volga, the battle for Stalingrad intensified.

evidence.title: 1942: Battle of Stalingrad: German forces of the 6th Army under general Friedrich Paulus reach the river bank of the Volga, capturing 90% of the ruined city of Stalingrad and splitting the remaining Soviet forces into two narrow pockets.

angle: Focus on the surreal, psychological paralysis of the German high command as front-line soldiers first glimpsed the Volga, realizing their supply lines were fatally overextended before a shot even bridged the river.
what_others_do: Existing videos typically focus on the broad tactical combat, the sheer scale of the city's destruction, or Hitler's personal obsession with capturing the city bearing Stalin's name.
